body:
WHAT
The app opens full screen, which hides the native title bar and (on Windows) its minimize/close buttons; packaged builds also have no native menu. Three exits are always available: F11 handled in the main process, VIEW → Toggle Full Screen in the app's own menu bar, and minimize / exit-full-screen / close buttons drawn in the app's top strip while full screen.

WHY
Without them a packaged Windows build had no visible way to leave full screen or close the window.

WHERE
app/main.js — wireWindowChrome(win): webContents "before-input-event" handler for key F11 → win.setFullScreen(!win.isFullScreen()); pushes "window:fullscreen" on enter/leave-full-screen and did-finish-load; ipcMain.on("window:control") handles "minimize", "close", "toggleFullScreen"; applyOpeningPosture(win) and shouldStartFullScreen() (app/main/config.js). app/renderer/modules/views.js — MENU_BAR VIEW item { label: "Toggle Full Screen", hint: "F11", action: toggleFullScreen }, toggleFullScreen() → window.magentra.windowControl("toggleFullScreen"), winMinimizeBtnEl / winFullScreenBtnEl / winCloseBtnEl handlers, onFullScreen listener toggling #windowControls hidden. app/renderer/index.html — <div id="windowControls" class="hidden"> with the three buttons.

TEST CHECKLIST
1. A keyDown input event with key 'F11' on the window's webContents toggles win.setFullScreen from true to false (and back), with no application menu present (Menu.setApplicationMenu(null) in packaged non-mac builds).
2. ipcMain 'window:control' with action 'toggleFullScreen' calls setFullScreen(!isFullScreen) on the sender's window; 'minimize' calls minimize(); 'close' calls close() on that window, not the main one.
3. The renderer receives 'window:fullscreen' true on did-finish-load when the window opened full screen, and #windowControls loses the hidden class; on leave-full-screen it receives false and the buttons hide again.
4. The VIEW menu contains an item labelled 'Toggle Full Screen' whose action sends windowControl('toggleFullScreen').
5. Clicking #winFullScreenBtn sends exactly one windowControl('toggleFullScreen') message.
